10/10 each visit.
Aug 2026 • Family
Popped in here one afternoon for a bite to eat. The staff are all amazing. We ordered 2 cheesy steak baguettes, a blue cheese pizza which was huge!! And chicken wings. The food was so tasty and big portions. Cocktails were delicious! They have some great drinks deals on during the day too. 
We came back 2 nights later and they had entertainment on. The place was buzzing, such a great atmosphere even though it was super busy staff were very friendly and service was quick. Great location for people watching and just a few streets away from all the business. So glad we found this place.
